'''Nambi Ghima''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Aki-Aki]] who resided on the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]]. At the [[Festival of the Ancestors]], Ghima gave [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] a [[Husk necklace|necklace]].<ref name="Episode IX" /> At the festival, she wore [[Color|blue]] [[daswoad]]-dyed [[robe]]s.<ref name="TROSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Biography==
===Festival of the Ancestors===
{{Dialogue|Ghima|«My name is Nambi Ghima.»|C-3PO|Her name is Nambi Ghima.|Rey|That's an excellent name. I'm Rey.|Ghima|«I would be honoured to your family name too.»|C-3PO|She would be honoured to your family name too.|Rey|I don't have one. I'm just Rey.|attr=Ghima asks for Rey's family name|src=<ref name="Episode IX" />}}
[[File:Nambi_Ghima_greets_Rey.png|left|thumb|245x245px|Ghima greets Rey on Pasaana during the Festival of the Ancestors]]
In the year [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROS date" /> Ghima was on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Pasaana]] during the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] held that [[Standard year|year]]. [[Resistance]] members [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], [[Finn]], [[Poe Dameron]], [[Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO]], and [[BB-8]] arrived on Pasaana to [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|find]] the [[Jedi hunter]] [[Ochi]] of [[Bestoon]] due to him carrying a the [[Blade of Ochi of Bestoon|clue]] he had to finding a [[Sith wayfinder]], Ghima approached Rey and introduced herself to her in her native language with C-3PO translating for her. Ghima then gave Rey a [[husk necklace]] and asked her what her name was. Rey then introduced herself as "Rey." Ghima asked the aspiring [[Jedi]] what her surname was but she replied that she did not have one. Rey was then later in a [[Force dyad|Force bond]] with [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], who snatched the necklace Ghima had given her and used it to locate her Resistance allies on Pasaana.<ref name="Episode IX" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nambi Ghima first appeared in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars saga|film]] [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. She was portrayed by [[Kiran Shah]], and voiced by [[Debra Wilson]].<ref name="Episode IX" /> According to Wilson, she was allowed to create her own "Gibberish" language for the character.<ref name="The George Lucas Talk Show">{{YouTube|video=50BkmbgHBXo|text=The George Lucas Talk Show Episode XXXIV with Tim Heidecker, Debra Wilson, Podcast: The Ride|channel=@TheGeorgeLucasTalkShow|name=The George Lucas Talk Show}}</ref>
